contract:
Phone profile editor. The campus and major pickers follow the student's university. Anchors are at HEAD.

1. Imports and data
- Replace `IU_CAMPUSES, campusByLabel` (:18) and `IU_MAJORS_BY_SCHOOL` (:19) with `campusesForSystem, campusBadgeFor, campusRowById, sharedWithCopy, type SchoolSystem` from @/lib/iu/campuses and `majorsForCampus` from @/lib/iu/majors.
- Owner bootstrap read (:370-384): also keep `schoolSystem`, `campusId`, `campusChangeAvailableAt` and `campusConfirmed` from r.data. The vibeRequest generic gains these fields. Keep reading the legacy `campus` only for the badge fallback.
- Visitors: unchanged (the visitor bootstrap sends none of these).

2. EditDraft.campus (:216-218)
- It becomes a campus ID ('' = no pick yet), seeded from the bootstrap `campusId` (seedDraftFromUser :585-592).
- Delete the campusByLabel badge fallback.

3. Save (:950-959)
- Stop sending `school` entirely.
- Send `campus_id` ONLY when the student changed the picker to a campus id different from the bootstrap campusId in this edit session.
- Never send '' and never re-send the current id: that would silently confirm a backfilled campus (profile-campus-write.ts header, lines 14-18).
- Replace the post-save mismatch check (:1004-1008) as follows:
  - if the response carries `campusError`, show `campusError.error` verbatim (server copy, e.g. "That campus isn't part of your university." or "You can change your campus again on October 15.") and reset draft.campus to the fresh bootstrap campusId, while the other fields count as saved;
  - a non-ok campus-only response shows `j.error` the same way;
  - only when neither is present and the fresh campusId differs from what was sent, show "Couldn't save your campus. Try again."
- Keep the major and year round-trip checks.

4. Campus picker UI (:1612-1657). The select is built from campusesForSystem(schoolSystem):
- option value = c.id;
- option text = campusBadgeFor(c.id, schoolSystem) ("IU Indianapolis" / "Purdue Indianapolis" for the shared campus, the full name otherwise), plus " (not open yet)" when !c.isOpen.
- Remove the "Campus — not set" option. When campusId is null, render a disabled, selected placeholder "Pick your campus".
- When schoolSystem is null, render no select, only the badge text.
- When campusChangeAvailableAt is in the future, disable the select and show "You can change campus again on {Month D}.", dated in America/Indiana/Indianapolis, the same format as campusChangeTooSoonCopy in profile-campus-write.ts:157-167.
- Hint (:1655-1656): replace "Sets which campus's clubs and events you see first. Not verified — change it any time." with "Your campus community: its clubs, events and map. Indianapolis is one community for IU and Purdue students." (plan §3.5, Settings row; must match B15 verbatim).
- When the selected campus is shared, append sharedWithCopy(row, system) as a second hint line.
- Rewrite the code comment at :1612-1616 without '@iu.edu proves IU membership' / 'never verified': the university comes from the verified school email and the campus is chosen within it.

5. Major picker (:1533-1581). list = majorsForCampus(draft campus || campusId, schoolSystem).
- With groups: render <optgroup label={group.school.shortLabel}>.
- With no groups (Bloomington): a flat list.
- list === null: replace the select with a free-text input (placeholder "Your major", maxLength 200).
- Keep the 'saved major not in list' extra option.

6. Optional (plan §3.6): the own-profile empty state (:2231-2236) "Open the feed →" becomes two CTAs, "Add a post" and "Add experience or a resume". Avatar upload via uploadAvatar (src/lib/profile/avatar-upload.ts) is optional; if done, keep the cropper and error copy.

7. Post edit: nothing in this file. The phone profile's ⋯ is PostViewerMobile (:1990-1995). If the PostViewerMobile owner adds an optional `onEdited` prop, wire `onEdited={() => void refetchPosts()}` only in a run AFTER that lands.

Do not delete the IU_CAMPUSES / campusByLabel shims in campuses.ts: SettingsClient.tsx:12 (B15) still imports them.
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; npx eslint src/components/mobile/ProfileMobile.tsx gives ≤ 11 problems (baseline at f23bc5d).
rg -n "IU_CAMPUSES|campusByLabel|IU_MAJORS_BY_SCHOOL|Not\s*verified — change it any time|body.school" src/components/mobile/ProfileMobile.tsx → 0.
rg -n "campus_id" src/components/mobile/ProfileMobile.tsx shows exactly one send site, guarded by 'changed from bootstrap campusId'.

375×812 screenshots of the edit sheet on prod: IU user (Indianapolis sub-line visible, no 'not set' option); Purdue user, simulated by an in-page fetch override of profile-bootstrap with schoolSystem='purdue' (the picker lists Indianapolis, Fort Wayne and Purdue campuses; majors show the Purdue Indianapolis list); cooldown state (override campusChangeAvailableAt to a future date → select disabled + date line); campusError state (override the profile-sync response with 200 {ok:true, campusError:{code:'campus_not_in_system', error:"That campus isn't part of your university."}}).

NO real campus writes from agents: every campus-picker save is exercised only through a fetch override. A real PATCH would stamp campus_set_at on Franky's account (confirming his campus and starting a 30-day lock).
Editing only the bio sends no campus_id and no school key (inspect the request body under an override).
